newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder raises Exxon yr.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder raises Exxon yr.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim has raised in 1997 earnings per share forecast for Exxon Corp to $2.90 from $2.73 after it reported EPS of $0.87 for the first quarter, above analysts' forecasts of $0.83 and Schroder's own $0.80.

-- Analyst Michael Mayer said that the primary reasons for the better than expected first quarter were foreign downstream, which was $0.04 above Schroder estimates and corporate finance, where charges fell to $61 million from expectations of $110-130 million per quarter.

-- Mayer said that although Exxon shares are up 11 percent this year he is maintaining his "outperform" rating as major oils will outperform the market and Exxon will grow dividends and continue to buy back stock. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
